name: Leaf village rooftop
description: a peaceful ninja village of warm tiled rooftops, wooden tea terrace, distant green mountains with carved stone faces, hanging leaves and orange morning light

name: Sunny pirate harbour
description: a cheerful seaside pirate harbour, wooden deck terrace, colourful coastal cottages, round sailing ships far away, turquoise sea and fluffy summer clouds

name: Wisteria tea garden
description: a serene Japanese tea veranda surrounded by cascading violet wisteria, red bridge over a koi pond, lanterns and soft golden morning light

name: Rainy Tokyo study
description: a cosy modern Japanese study with tall rain-streaked windows overlooking Tokyo, soft violet neon, books and plants, warm desk lamps and blue evening sky

name: Island lookout
description: a peaceful tropical island veranda, a tiny pink seaside cottage, palm trees, blue ocean, distant islands and bright gentle sunshine

name: Storybook meadow
description: a warm storybook cottage terrace above lush green meadows, wildflowers and old windmills, fluffy clouds, distant alpine village, gentle painterly Japanese animation atmosphere

name: Elegant city apartment
description: a warm elegant 1930s European city apartment with velvet sofa, walnut bookshelves, flowering plants, tall windows showing a quiet old town, afternoon sunlight

name: Moonlit observatory
description: a dreamy magical observatory balcony with crescent moon, huge starry sky, pastel celestial globe, soft lavender curtains, flower pots and moonlit clouds

name: Sunlit school clubroom
description: a cosy Japanese school clubroom with wooden desks, books and a volleyball on a shelf, broad open windows facing trees and a sports field, golden after-school sunlight

description: a bright idyllic small village for friendly creatures with red-roofed pastel cottages, lakeside footpath, flower beds and grassy hills, cosy porch in foreground

description: a sunlit enchanted forest clearing with ancient mossy stone shrine arches, turquoise carvings, tiny luminous fireflies, lush ferns, soft rays and a wooden platform in foreground

name: Emerald hill terrace
description: joyful emerald grassy hills, stylized checker-pattern earth cliffs, looping distant stone path, sunflowers, bright turquoise lake and palm trees, clean wooden lookout platform foreground

description: an adorable pastel meadow floating among peach and lavender clouds, soft rounded star-shaped flowers, tiny crescent hills, distant candy-coloured cottages, cosy grassy ledge foreground

name: Blocky garden cabin
description: a cosy voxel block-built wooden cabin porch, block-shaped oak trees and flower garden, cubic mountain lake beyond, pixel-textured golden sunrise, familiar blockcraft game atmosphere

name: Harvest cottage garden
description: a richly detailed cosy pixel-art farming cottage porch, neat vegetable beds, pumpkin patch, apple trees, wooden fence, a distant mountain lake and warm late-summer sunshine

name: Windmill city balcony
description: a sunny fantasy European windmill city viewed from a flower-filled balcony, red tiled roofs, broad stone bridge, lake and rolling green hills, glowing dandelions

name: Astral train lounge
description: a cosy luxurious space-train lounge with huge arched windows showing stars and a blue planet, navy velvet seats, brass lamps, books and little plants, warm cream wood trim

name: Luminous city overlook
description: a cosy industrial loft balcony overlooking a vast layered sci-fi city with jade glowing energy towers, rain haze, warm houseplants and amber desk lights, calm blue evening

name: Lantern-lit underground
description: a beautiful cosy underground stone sanctuary with tall arched pillars, glowing blue flowers, little golden lanterns, gentle bioluminescent moss, quiet stream and comfortable wooden ledge

name: After-school cafe
description: a cosy Japanese backstreet cafe booth, warm coffee bar, shelves of cups, potted plants, rain-speckled windows with colourful evening city lights, relaxed retro atmosphere

name: Enchanted library
description: a cosy magical stone library with spiralling wooden shelves, warm lamps, floating dust motes, vines, arched windows showing a forest and distant castle, welcoming gentle fantasy atmosphere
